rows.access_level: ABSTRACT_ONLY (full text needed; Europe PMC: subscription required)
rows.design: split-body randomized single-blinded trial (abstract); registry lists masking as double (participant, outcomes assessor)
rows.body_site: limbs, one limb per arm (abstract); registry says each upper limb
rows.skin_tone: not in abstract (registry inclusion criterion: Fitzpatrick skin types III - V)
rows.analysis_unit: limb (median number of achromic lesions per limb, one limb per patient per arm)
rows.endpoint_definition: number of achromic lesions 30 days after treatment compared with baseline
rows.assessment_method: lesion count; who counted not in abstract (registry plan: two assessors count independently)
rows.time_from_last_treatment: 30 days after treatment (number of sessions not in abstract; full text needed to confirm this is after the final session)
rows.complete_match: not in abstract (endpoint counts achromic lesions; whether a lesion that left the count matches surrounding skin is not in abstract)
rows.dark_overshoot: not in abstract (abstract states there were no adverse events)
rows.texture_or_scar: not in abstract (abstract states there were no adverse events)
rows.citation: Arbache S, Hirata SH. Dermatol Surg 2023;49(6):603-608
rows.lesions_enrolled: not in abstract as a total (median 32 achromic lesions per 5FU limb at baseline, IQR 23-37)
rows.intervention: 5-fluorouracil delivered with a tattoo machine (number of sessions not in abstract)
rows.comparator: saline delivered with a tattoo machine, contralateral limb
rows.arm_result: median achromic lesions 32 (IQR 23-37) at baseline to 12 (IQR 6-18) after treatment; p = .000003
rows.patient_noticeability: All participants were satisfied or very satisfied with results on 5FU-treated limbs (scale not in abstract; registry plans a Likert scale)
rows.uncertainty: Between-arm reduction p = .00003 (abstract). months_after_final_tx 1 is [30 days] converted to months; the abstract says '30 days after treatment' but does not give the number of sessions, so the full text is needed to confirm the count is from the final session. Registry enrollment is 30 (ESTIMATED) against 29 included. Abstract says single-blinded; registry says double masking. Registry calls the comparator conventional microneedling; arms are 5FU vs saline delivered with a tattoo machine. Lesion totals across patients, per-lesion size and lesions per limb beyond the median are not in abstract. Same registered trial as arbache2018 (preliminary report); count the cohort once.
